use axum::{routing::{get, post}, Router, response::Html};
use tokio::net::TcpStream;
use tokio::io::{AsyncWriteExt, AsyncReadExt};
use std::fs;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let app = Router::new()
        .route("/", get(serve_dashboard))
        .route("/api/deploy", post(deploy_wasm_payload));

    println!("=======================================================");
    println!("☁️ NEXUS CLOUD WEB SERVER RUNNING ON http://localhost:3000");
    println!("=======================================================");

    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("0.0.0.0:3000").await.unwrap();
    axum::serve(listener, app).await.unwrap();
}

async fn serve_dashboard() -> Html<&'static str> {
    Html(include_str!("index.html"))
}

async fn deploy_wasm_payload() -> (axum::http::StatusCode, String) {
    let wasm_path = "../nexus-ai-contract/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/nexus_ai_contract.wasm";
    
    let wasm_payload = match fs::read(wasm_path) {
        Ok(data) => data,
        Err(_) => return (axum::http::StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, "[ERROR] AI WASM FILE NOT FOUND. COMPILE IT FIRST.".to_string()),
    };

    let mut frame = Vec::new();
    frame.extend_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF]); 
    frame.extend_from_slice(&[0x99, 0x88, 0x77, 0x66, 0x55, 0x44]); 
    frame.push(0x88); frame.push(0xB5); 
    frame.push(0x03); 
    frame.extend_from_slice(&wasm_payload); 

    match TcpStream::connect("127.0.0.1:9999").await {
        Ok(mut stream) => {
            if stream.write_all(&frame).await.is_ok() {
                // 🚀 TWO-WAY SYNC: Read execution result back from OS Bare-Metal Node!
                let mut response_buf = [0u8; 64];
                match stream.read(&mut response_buf).await {
                    Ok(n) if n > 0 => {
                        let result_msg = String::from_utf8_lossy(&response_buf[..n]);
                        (axum::http::StatusCode::OK, format!("[OK] EXECUTED ON SWARM! RESULT: {}", result_msg))
                    }
                    _ => (axum::http::StatusCode::OK, format!("[OK] DEPLOYED {} BYTES TO AI ENGINE (ASYNC EXECUTION)", wasm_payload.len()))
                }
            } else {
                (axum::http::StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "[ERROR] FAILED TO TRANSMIT TO HARDWARE.".to_string())
            }
        }
        Err(_) => {
            (axum::http::StatusCode::SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, "[ERROR] NODE OFFLINE. BOOT QEMU OS FIRST.".to_string())
        }
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/ai.rs

extern crate alloc;

// 🚀 BARE-METAL PERCEPTRON (Fixed-Point Math Engine)
pub struct Perceptron {
    weights: [i32; 3], 
    bias: i32,
}

impl Perceptron {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        // 🚀 RECALIBRATED WEIGHTS (The Intelligence Upgrade)
        // W1 (Packet Size) is now low impact. W2 (Errors) and W3 (Latency) are high impact.
        Perceptron {
            weights: [2, 100, 5], 
            bias: -500,            
        }
    }

    pub fn predict(&self, inputs: [i32; 3]) -> i32 {
        let mut sum = self.bias;
        for i in 0..3 {
            sum += self.weights[i] * inputs[i];
        }
        
        // If Sum > 5000, it's a DDoS attack
        if sum > 5000 { 1 } else { 0 }
    }
}

pub static NEXUS_BRAIN: Perceptron = Perceptron::new();

pub fn run_inference(_task_id: u64, inputs: [i32; 3], row: usize) -> i32 {
    let msg = alloc::format!("AI: TENSOR COMPUTE ENGAGED -> INPUTS {:?}  ", inputs);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(row, &msg, 0x0D); 
    
    // Simulating heavy core load
    for _ in 0..8_000_000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); }
    
    let prediction = NEXUS_BRAIN.predict(inputs);
    
    if prediction == 1 {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(row + 1, "AI: INFERENCE -> [ THREAT DETECTED - DROP PACKETS ] ", 0x0C); 
    } else {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(row + 1, "AI: INFERENCE -> [ SYSTEM SECURE - ROUTE TRAFFIC ]  ", 0x0A); 
    }
    
    prediction
}

pub fn execute_ai_scan() {
    // Shifted up to Row 17
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(17, "AI: LOADING NEXUS NEURAL WEIGHTS TO CPU L1 CACHE...", 0x0E); 

    // Scenario 1: Normal Network Traffic 
    let safe_telemetry = [150, 0, 12];
    run_inference(1, safe_telemetry, 18); // Writes to 18 and 19

    for _ in 0..10_000_000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); } // Pause for visual effect

    // Scenario 2: DDoS / Malicious Traffic 
    let threat_telemetry = [1500, 50, 999];
    run_inference(2, threat_telemetry, 20); // Writes to 20 and 21. (Rows 22, 23, 24 are now safe for the shell!)
}

extern crate alloc;
use alloc::string::{String, ToString};
use alloc::vec::Vec;
use crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen;
use pc_keyboard::{layouts, DecodedKey, HandleControl, Keyboard, ScancodeSet1};
use spin::Mutex;
use lazy_static::lazy_static;
use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;

lazy_static! {
    static ref KEYBOARD: Mutex<Keyboard<layouts::Us104Key, ScancodeSet1>> =
        Mutex::new(Keyboard::new(layouts::Us104Key, ScancodeSet1, HandleControl::Ignore));
    static ref INPUT_BUFFER: Mutex<String> = Mutex::new(String::new());
}

pub fn handle_keyboard_interrupt() {
    let mut keyboard = KEYBOARD.lock();
    let mut data_port = Port::new(0x60);
    let scancode: u8 = unsafe { data_port.read() };

    if let Ok(Some(key_event)) = keyboard.add_byte(scancode) {
        if let Some(key) = keyboard.process_keyevent(key_event) {
            match key {
                DecodedKey::Unicode(character) => {
                    if character == '\n' {
                        let command = {
                            let mut buffer = INPUT_BUFFER.lock();
                            let cmd = buffer.clone();
                            buffer.clear();
                            cmd
                        };
                        execute_command(command);
                    } else if character == '\x08' {
                        let mut buffer = INPUT_BUFFER.lock();
                        buffer.pop();
                        render_input_line(&buffer);
                    } else {
                        let mut buffer = INPUT_BUFFER.lock();
                        buffer.push(character);
                        render_input_line(&buffer);
                    }
                }
                DecodedKey::RawKey(_) => {}
            }
        }
    }
}

fn render_input_line(buffer: &str) {
    let display_str = alloc::format!("NEXUS-CLI> {}_               ", buffer);
    write_result_to_screen(24, &display_str, 0x0F);
}

fn execute_command(command: String) {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = command.split_whitespace().collect();
    if parts.is_empty() { return; }

    match parts[0] {
        "help" => write_result_to_screen(20, "SYS_CMDS: 'help', 'status', 'peers', 'storage'", 0x0A),
        "status" => write_result_to_screen(20, "SYS_STATUS: CORE ONLINE | NVME SECURED | BFT ACTIVE", 0x0B),
        "peers" => {
            let table = crate::routing::MESH_NETWORK.lock();
            write_result_to_screen(20, &alloc::format!("KADEMLIA DHT: Active L2 Peers: {}", table.peers.len()), 0x0D);
        },
        "storage" => {
            if parts.len() > 1 {
                let file_name = alloc::format!("task_witness_{}.sig", parts[1]);
                if let Some(file_data) = crate::vfs::read_file(&file_name) {
                    let hex = if file_data.len() >= 4 {
                        alloc::format!("{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}{:02X}", file_data[0], file_data[1], file_data[2], file_data[3])
                    } else { "N/A".to_string() };
                    write_result_to_screen(20, &alloc::format!("VFS READ: {} -> HEX: {}", file_name, hex), 0x0B);
                } else {
                    write_result_to_screen(20, "VFS ERROR: WITNESS FILE NOT FOUND", 0x0C);
                }
            } else {
                write_result_to_screen(20, "VFS ERROR: SPECIFY TASK ID (e.g., 'storage 888')", 0x0E);
            }
        },
        _ => write_result_to_screen(20, "CLI ERROR: UNKNOWN COMMAND", 0x0C),
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/compositor.rs

use crate::spinlock::SpinLock;

// 80 columns * 25 rows * 2 bytes (character + color) = 4000 bytes in RAM
pub static OFF_SCREEN_BUFFER: SpinLock<[u8; 4000]> = SpinLock::new([0; 4000]);

pub fn write_to_buffer(row: isize, text: &str, color: u8) {
    if row < 0 || row >= 25 { return; } // Boundary check
    
    let mut buffer = OFF_SCREEN_BUFFER.lock();
    let mut current_col = 0;
    
    for byte in text.bytes() {
        if current_col >= 80 { break; } // Prevent line overflow
        let offset = (row as usize * 80 + current_col) * 2;
        
        // Write to RAM, NOT directly to hardware VGA
        if offset + 1 < 4000 {
            buffer[offset] = byte;
            buffer[offset + 1] = color;
        }
        current_col += 1;
    }
}

// Only the UI thread will call this to blast the RAM frame to the Monitor
pub fn flush_to_monitor() {
    let buffer = OFF_SCREEN_BUFFER.lock();
    let hardware_vga = 0xb8000 as *mut u8;
    
    unsafe {
        // Blazing fast DMA-style memory copy (Zero Tearing)
        core::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(buffer.as_ptr(), hardware_vga, 4000);
    }
}

#![allow(dead_code)]
use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};
use spin::Mutex;
use alloc::format;

pub static GLOBAL_TRUST: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(100);
pub static NETWORK_TVL: Mutex<u32> = Mutex::new(930); // Genesis TVL

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum PbftState { Idle, PrePrepare, Prepare, Commit }

pub struct PbftEngine { 
    pub state: PbftState, 
    pub bit_vector_votes: u64, 
    pub total_nodes: u8 
}

impl PbftEngine {
    pub const fn new() -> Self { 
        Self { state: PbftState::Idle, bit_vector_votes: 0, total_nodes: 4 } 
    }
    
    // 🚀 O(1) SWAR VOTING MATH (3f + 1 Quorum)
    pub fn has_quorum(&self) -> bool { 
        let required_votes = ((2 * self.total_nodes) / 3) + 1;
        (self.bit_vector_votes.count_ones() as u8) >= required_votes 
    }
    
    pub fn process_vote(&mut self, node_index: u8) { 
        self.bit_vector_votes |= 1 << node_index; 
    }
    
    pub fn reset(&mut self) {
        self.state = PbftState::Idle;
        self.bit_vector_votes = 0;
    }
}

pub static ENGINE: Mutex<PbftEngine> = Mutex::new(PbftEngine::new());

pub fn init_pbft_engine() { 
    crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[BFT] O(1) SWAR VOTING & 3F+1 QUORUM ACTIVE.", 11); // Cyan
}

pub fn verify_compute(result: u32, compute_cycles: u32) -> bool {
    crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[BFT] INITIATING pBFT PRE-PREPARE PHASE...", 13); // Purple
    
    let mut engine = ENGINE.lock();
    engine.state = PbftState::PrePrepare;
    
    // Simulate Network Votes (Nodes 0, 1, and 2 vote YES)
    engine.process_vote(0); 
    engine.process_vote(1); 
    engine.process_vote(2);
    
    if engine.has_quorum() {
        engine.state = PbftState::Commit;
        
        // 🚀 Fetch dynamic reward from Surge Pricing Engine
        let reward = crate::tokenomics::execute_payout("WASM_TASK", compute_cycles as u64 * 10, 2, 9999);
        
        let mut tvl = NETWORK_TVL.lock();
        *tvl += reward; 
        
        // Simulating physical disk write for now to avoid UEFI crashes
        // let mut sector_data = [0u8; 512];
        // sector_data[0..4].copy_from_slice(&tvl.to_le_bytes()); 
        // crate::disk::write_sector(2048, &sector_data);
        
        let msg = format!("[BFT] QUORUM REACHED! RESULT {} VALIDATED.", result);
        crate::graphics::update_terminal_log(&msg, 10);
        
        let msg2 = format!("[VAULT] PERMANENT BURN: NEW NETWORK TVL {} NXC SECURED.", *tvl);
        crate::graphics::update_terminal_log(&msg2, 10);

        engine.reset(); // Reset for next task
        return true;
    } else {
        crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[BFT] QUORUM FAILED. SLASHING ACTORS!", 12); // Red
        engine.reset();
        return false;
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/crypto.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;
use alloc::format;

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
use core::arch::x86_64::_rdtsc;

// 🚀 THE FIX: Bulletproof PRNG (Bypasses missing RDRAND hardware instruction in QEMU)
pub fn get_random_bytes(buffer: &mut [u8]) {
    let mut i = 0;
    
    // Seed the PRNG using the CPU's Time Stamp Counter (RDTSC)
    let mut seed = unsafe { _rdtsc() }; 
    
    while i < buffer.len() {
        // Linear Congruential Generator (LCG) Math to scramble the bits safely
        seed = seed.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        
        let bytes = seed.to_ne_bytes();
        let chunk_size = core::cmp::min(8, buffer.len() - i);
        buffer[i..i + chunk_size].copy_from_slice(&bytes[..chunk_size]);
        i += chunk_size;
    }
}

// 🚀 INTERNAL CONSENSUS: FNV-1a 32-bit (For BFT and Wasm Node Verification)
pub fn fnv1a_hash(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut hash: u32 = 0x811C9DC5;
    for &byte in data {
        hash ^= byte as u32;
        hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x01000193);
    }
    hash
}

pub fn generate_pouc_proof(task_id: u64, result: i32) -> u32 {
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(13, "CRYPTO: GENERATING PoUC ZK-PROOF...         ", 0x0E); 
    
    // Simulate intense cryptographic math operations
    for _ in 0..4_000_000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); }

    let mut payload = [0u8; 12];
    payload[0..8].copy_from_slice(&task_id.to_be_bytes());
    payload[8..12].copy_from_slice(&result.to_be_bytes());

    let signature = fnv1a_hash(&payload);

    let msg = format!("CRYPTO: PROOF VERIFIED! HASH: 0x{:08X} ", signature);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(14, &msg, 0x0B); 
    
    signature
}

// 🚀 EXTERNAL NETWORK RPC: FNV-1a 64-bit (For incoming Mac Terminal Payloads)
pub fn generate_pouc_hash(payload: &str) -> u64 {
    let mut hash: u64 = 0xcbf29ce484222325; // FNV offset basis
    for byte in payload.bytes() {
        hash ^= byte as u64;
        hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x100000001b3); // FNV prime
    }
    hash
}

FILE: ./nexus-core/src/crypto_rng.rs

#[cfg(target_arch = "x86_64")]
use core::arch::x86_64::{_rdrand64_step, _rdtsc};

/// Generates cryptographically secure random bytes directly from the CPU silicon.
/// This completely bypasses the need for an underlying OS (like Linux /dev/urandom).
pub fn get_random_bytes(buffer: &mut [u8]) {
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < buffer.len() {
        let mut rand_val: u64 = 0;
        let mut success = 0;
        
        // Try to get hardware randomness directly from the CPU (RDRAND instruction)
        unsafe {
            // Retry a few times in case the hardware entropy pool is temporarily exhausted
            for _ in 0..10 {
                success = _rdrand64_step(&mut rand_val);
                if success == 1 {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // Fallback to Time Stamp Counter (RDTSC) if RDRAND is unavailable or exhausted
        if success != 1 {
            unsafe {
                rand_val = _rdtsc();
            }
        }

        // Write the 8 bytes (or remaining bytes) into our target buffer
        let bytes = rand_val.to_ne_bytes();
        let chunk_size = core::cmp::min(8, buffer.len() - i);
        buffer[i..i + chunk_size].copy_from_slice(&bytes[..chunk_size]);
        i += chunk_size;
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/disk.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]

extern crate alloc;
use core::arch::asm;
use x86_64::instructions::port::{Port, PortReadOnly};

const ATA_DATA_PORT: u16 = 0x1F0;
const ATA_SECTOR_COUNT_PORT: u16 = 0x1F2;
const ATA_LBA_LO_PORT: u16 = 0x1F3;
const ATA_LBA_MID_PORT: u16 = 0x1F4;
const ATA_LBA_HI_PORT: u16 = 0x1F5;
const ATA_DRIVE_PORT: u16 = 0x1F6;
const ATA_COMMAND_PORT: u16 = 0x1F7;
const ATA_STATUS_PORT: u16 = 0x1F7;

pub fn initialize_disk() {
    crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[STORAGE] PROBING PRIMARY ATA/IDE BUS...", 0);
    // Slight delay for hardware spinup
    for _ in 0..1_000_000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); }
    crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[STORAGE] PHYSICAL HARD DISK DETECTED AND READY!", 0);
}

// 🚀 WRITE A FULL 512-BYTE SECTOR TO PHYSICAL DISK
pub fn write_sector(lba: u32, data: &[u8; 512]) {
    unsafe {
        // Select Drive 0 and send LBA coordinates
        Port::new(ATA_DRIVE_PORT).write(0xE0 | ((lba >> 24) & 0x0F) as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_SECTOR_COUNT_PORT).write(1u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_LO_PORT).write(lba as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_MID_PORT).write((lba >> 8) as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_HI_PORT).write((lba >> 16) as u8);
        
        // Command 0x30 = Write Sectors
        Port::new(ATA_COMMAND_PORT).write(0x30u8); 

        if wait_for_disk() {
            let mut data_port: Port<u16> = Port::new(ATA_DATA_PORT);
            // Push 256 words (512 bytes) onto the bus
            for i in 0..256 {
                let word = (data[i * 2] as u16) | ((data[i * 2 + 1] as u16) << 8);
                data_port.write(word);
            }
            
            // Cache Flush (0xE7) to force physical magnetic write immediately
            Port::new(ATA_COMMAND_PORT).write(0xE7u8);
        }
    }
}

// 🚀 READ A SECTOR FROM PHYSICAL DISK
pub fn read_sector(lba: u32, buffer: &mut [u8; 512]) -> bool {
    unsafe {
        Port::new(ATA_DRIVE_PORT).write(0xE0 | ((lba >> 24) & 0x0F) as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_SECTOR_COUNT_PORT).write(1u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_LO_PORT).write(lba as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_MID_PORT).write((lba >> 8) as u8);
        Port::new(ATA_LBA_HI_PORT).write((lba >> 16) as u8);
        
        // Command 0x20 = Read Sectors
        Port::new(ATA_COMMAND_PORT).write(0x20u8); 

        if wait_for_disk() {
            let mut data_port: PortReadOnly<u16> = PortReadOnly::new(ATA_DATA_PORT);
            for i in 0..256 {
                let word = data_port.read();
                buffer[i * 2] = (word & 0xFF) as u8;
                buffer[i * 2 + 1] = (word >> 8) as u8;
            }
            return true;
        }
        false
    }
}

// Anti-Deadlock Timeout and Electrical Delay
fn wait_for_disk() -> bool {
    let mut status_port: PortReadOnly<u8> = PortReadOnly::new(ATA_STATUS_PORT);
    unsafe {
        // 400ns electrical delay to allow the IDE bus to stabilize
        for _ in 0..1000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); } 
        
        // Timeout loop to prevent CPU deadlocking
        for _ in 0..5_000_000 {
            let status = status_port.read();
            if status & 0x80 == 0 { return true; } // BSY cleared, disk is ready
            core::hint::spin_loop();
        }
        false
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/e1000.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]

use alloc::vec::Vec;
use core::sync::atomic::{Ordering, AtomicUsize};
use core::arch::asm;

const REG_RCTRL: usize     = 0x0100;
const REG_RXDESCLO: usize  = 0x2800;
const REG_RXDESCHI: usize  = 0x2804;
const REG_RXDESCLEN: usize = 0x2808;
const REG_RXDESCHEAD: usize = 0x2810;
const REG_RXDESCTAIL: usize = 0x2818;

const REG_TCTRL: usize     = 0x0400;
const REG_TXDESCLO: usize  = 0x3800;
const REG_TXDESCHI: usize  = 0x3804;
const REG_TXDESCLEN: usize = 0x3808;
const REG_TXDESCHEAD: usize = 0x3810;
const REG_TXDESCTAIL: usize = 0x3818;

const REG_RAL: usize = 0x5400;
const REG_RAH: usize = 0x5404;

const REG_ICR: usize = 0x00C0; // Interrupt Cause Read
const REG_IMS: usize = 0x00D0; // Interrupt Mask Set

pub static mut E1000_BAR0: usize = 0;
pub static mut MAC_ADDRESS: [u8; 6] = [0; 6];

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct RXDescriptor {
    pub address: u64, pub length: u16, pub checksum: u16,
    pub status: u8, pub errors: u8, pub special: u16,
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct TXDescriptor {
    pub address: u64, pub length: u16, pub cso: u8, pub cmd: u8,
    pub status: u8, pub css: u8, pub special: u16,
}

// 🚀 BLUEPRINT COMPLIANCE: 128-Byte Alignment to prevent L1 Cache False Sharing
#[repr(C, align(128))]
#[derive(Clone, Copy)]
pub struct NexusDmaQueue {
    pub data: [u8; 2048],
}

const NUM_RX_DESC: usize = 32; 
const NUM_TX_DESC: usize = 32; 

static mut RX_RING: [RXDescriptor; NUM_RX_DESC] = [RXDescriptor { address: 0, length: 0, checksum: 0, status: 0, errors: 0, special: 0 }; NUM_RX_DESC];
static mut TX_RING: [TXDescriptor; NUM_TX_DESC] = [TXDescriptor { address: 0, length: 0, cso: 0, cmd: 0, status: 0, css: 0, special: 0 }; NUM_TX_DESC];

const INIT_DMA: NexusDmaQueue = NexusDmaQueue { data: [0; 2048] };
static mut RX_BUFFERS: [NexusDmaQueue; NUM_RX_DESC] = [INIT_DMA; NUM_RX_DESC];
static mut TX_BUFFERS: [NexusDmaQueue; NUM_TX_DESC] = [INIT_DMA; NUM_TX_DESC];

static RX_CUR_INDEX: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static TX_CUR_INDEX: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);

unsafe fn write_reg(offset: usize, value: u32) { core::ptr::write_volatile((E1000_BAR0 + offset) as *mut u32, value); }
unsafe fn read_reg(offset: usize) -> u32 { core::ptr::read_volatile((E1000_BAR0 + offset) as *const u32) }

// Hardware Cache Line Flush (CLFLUSH)
#[inline(always)]
unsafe fn clflush(addr: usize) {
    asm!("clflush [{}]", in(reg) addr);
}

// In nexus-core/src/e1000.rs

pub fn init_dma_network() {
    if let Some(device) = crate::pci::scan_buses() {
        unsafe {
            E1000_BAR0 = (device.bar0 & 0xFFFFFFF0) as usize;
            
            let ral = read_reg(REG_RAL);
            let rah = read_reg(REG_RAH);
            
            MAC_ADDRESS[0] = (ral & 0xFF) as u8; MAC_ADDRESS[1] = ((ral >> 8) & 0xFF) as u8;
            MAC_ADDRESS[2] = ((ral >> 16) & 0xFF) as u8; MAC_ADDRESS[3] = ((ral >> 24) & 0xFF) as u8;
            MAC_ADDRESS[4] = (rah & 0xFF) as u8; MAC_ADDRESS[5] = ((rah >> 8) & 0xFF) as u8;

            for i in 0..NUM_RX_DESC {
                RX_RING[i].address = core::ptr::addr_of!(RX_BUFFERS[i].data) as u64;
                RX_RING[i].status = 0;
            }
            let rx_phys = core::ptr::addr_of!(RX_RING) as u64;
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCLO, (rx_phys & 0xFFFFFFFF) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCHI, (rx_phys >> 32) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCLEN, (NUM_RX_DESC * core::mem::size_of::<RXDescriptor>()) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCHEAD, 0);
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCTAIL, (NUM_RX_DESC - 1) as u32);
            
          // 🚀 BARE-METAL PROMISCUOUS MODE (NO LOOPBACK)
            // Bit 1 = EN, Bit 3 = UPE, Bit 4 = MPE, Bit 15 = BAM, Bit 26 = SECRC
            write_reg(REG_RCTRL, (1 << 1) | (1 << 3) | (1 << 4) | (1 << 15) | (1 << 26));
            for i in 0..NUM_TX_DESC {
                TX_RING[i].address = core::ptr::addr_of!(TX_BUFFERS[i].data) as u64;
                TX_RING[i].status = 1; 
            }
            let tx_phys = core::ptr::addr_of!(TX_RING) as u64;
            write_reg(REG_TXDESCLO, (tx_phys & 0xFFFFFFFF) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_TXDESCHI, (tx_phys >> 32) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_TXDESCLEN, (NUM_TX_DESC * core::mem::size_of::<TXDescriptor>()) as u32);
            write_reg(REG_TXDESCHEAD, 0);
            write_reg(REG_TXDESCTAIL, 0);

            write_reg(REG_TCTRL, (1 << 1) | (1 << 3) | (0x0F << 4) | (0x3F << 12));
            
            write_reg(REG_IMS, 0x1F6DC); 
            read_reg(REG_ICR);           

            crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[NET] Zero-Copy DMA Aligned (128B). False Sharing Prevented.", 2);
            crate::graphics::update_terminal_log("[NET] PROMISCUOUS RX MODE ENABLED.", 11);
        }
    }
}

// In nexus-core/src/e1000.rs

pub fn poll_packet() -> Option<alloc::vec::Vec<u8>> {
    unsafe {
        if E1000_BAR0 == 0 { return None; } 
        let cur = RX_CUR_INDEX.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let desc = &mut RX_RING[cur];

        // Status Bit 0 (DD) indicates Descriptor Done (Packet Received)
        if (desc.status & 1) == 1 {
            let len = desc.length as usize;
            let mut packet = alloc::vec::Vec::with_capacity(len);
            packet.extend_from_slice(&RX_BUFFERS[cur].data[..len]);
            
            clflush(core::ptr::addr_of!(RX_BUFFERS[cur]) as usize);

            // Clear status and give the descriptor back to hardware
            desc.status = 0;
            write_reg(REG_RXDESCTAIL, cur as u32);
            
            let next = (cur + 1) % NUM_RX_DESC;
            RX_CUR_INDEX.store(next, Ordering::Relaxed);
            
            return Some(packet);
        }
    }
    None
}
pub fn send_packet(data: &[u8]) {
    unsafe {
        if E1000_BAR0 == 0 { return; }
        
        let cur = TX_CUR_INDEX.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        let len = data.len().min(2048);
        
        for i in 0..len {
            TX_BUFFERS[cur].data[i] = data[i];
        }

        clflush(core::ptr::addr_of!(TX_BUFFERS[cur]) as usize);

        TX_RING[cur].length = len as u16;
        TX_RING[cur].cmd = 0b0000_1011; 
        TX_RING[cur].status = 0;

        let next = (cur + 1) % NUM_TX_DESC;
        TX_CUR_INDEX.store(next, Ordering::Relaxed);
        write_reg(REG_TXDESCTAIL, next as u32);
    }
}

pub fn ack_interrupt() {
    unsafe { if E1000_BAR0 != 0 { read_reg(REG_ICR); } }
}

use alloc::format;
use crate::nic_driver::transmit_raw_packet;
use crate::spinlock::SpinLock;
use core::fmt::Write;
use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;

pub static PRINT_LOCK: SpinLock<()> = SpinLock::new(());

struct SerialPort;
impl Write for SerialPort {
    fn write_str(&mut self, s: &str) -> core::fmt::Result {
        let mut port = Port::new(0x3F8); 
        for byte in s.bytes() { unsafe { port.write(byte); } }
        Ok(())
    }
}

pub fn process_rx_packet(packet: &[u8]) {
    if packet.len() < 14 { return; }
    let ethertype = (packet[12] as u16) << 8 | (packet[13] as u16);
    match ethertype {
        0x0806 => handle_arp(packet),  
        0x0800 => handle_ipv4(packet), 
        _ => {} 
    }
}

fn handle_arp(packet: &[u8]) {
    if packet.len() < 42 { return; }
    let opcode = (packet[20] as u16) << 8 | (packet[21] as u16);
    if opcode == 1 { 
        let mut sender_mac = [0u8; 6]; sender_mac.copy_from_slice(&packet[22..28]);
        let mut sender_ip = [0u8; 4]; sender_ip.copy_from_slice(&packet[28..32]);
        let mut target_ip = [0u8; 4]; target_ip.copy_from_slice(&packet[38..42]);

        if target_ip == [192, 168, 1, 100] || target_ip == [10, 0, 2, 15] {
            host_log("   📡 [ ARP ] Router Request Accepted. Sending MAC identity...");
            let my_mac = [0x52, 0x54, 0x00, 0x12, 0x34, 0x56];
            let mut reply = [0u8; 64]; 
            reply[0..6].copy_from_slice(&sender_mac);
            reply[6..12].copy_from_slice(&my_mac);
            reply[12..14].copy_from_slice(&[0x08, 0x06]);
            reply[14..20].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x01, 0x08, 0x00, 0x06, 0x04]);
            reply[20..22].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x02]); 
            reply[22..28].copy_from_slice(&my_mac);
            reply[28..32].copy_from_slice(&target_ip);
            reply[32..38].copy_from_slice(&sender_mac);
            reply[38..42].copy_from_slice(&sender_ip);
            transmit_raw_packet(&reply);
        }
    }
}

fn handle_ipv4(packet: &[u8]) {
    if packet.len() < 34 { return; }
    let protocol = packet[23];

    if protocol == 1 { 
        let icmp_type = packet[34];
        if icmp_type == 8 { 
            host_log("   ⚡ [ ICMP ] PING Received! Sending Echo Reply...");
            let mut reply = [0u8; 128]; 
            let len = packet.len();
            if len > 128 { return; }
            reply[0..len].copy_from_slice(&packet[0..len]);
            for i in 0..6 { reply[i] = packet[i+6]; reply[i+6] = packet[i]; }
            for i in 0..4 { reply[26+i] = packet[30+i]; reply[30+i] = packet[26+i]; }
            reply[34] = 0; reply[36] = 0; reply[37] = 0; 
            let mut sum: u32 = 0;
            for i in (34..len).step_by(2) {
                let word = (reply[i] as u32) << 8 | (reply[i+1] as u32);
                sum = sum.wrapping_add(word);
            }
            while (sum >> 16) > 0 { sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + (sum >> 16); }
            let checksum = !(sum as u16);
            reply[36] = (checksum >> 8) as u8;
            reply[37] = (checksum & 0xFF) as u8;
            transmit_raw_packet(&reply[0..len]);
        }
    } 
    else if protocol == 17 { 
        let ip_header_len = (packet[14] & 0x0F) as usize * 4;
        let udp_header_start = 14 + ip_header_len;
        
        if packet.len() >= udp_header_start + 8 {
            let dst_port = (packet[udp_header_start + 2] as u16) << 8 | (packet[udp_header_start + 3] as u16);
            
            if dst_port == 7777 {
                let payload_start = udp_header_start + 8;
                
                // 🎯 THE NEW MAGIC: Cloud RPC (Remote Procedure Call) Engine
                if packet.len() >= payload_start + 6 && &packet[payload_start..payload_start+4] == b"CMPT" {
                    let num1 = packet[payload_start+4];
                    let num2 = packet[payload_start+5];
                    host_log(&format!("   ☁️ [ CLOUD RPC ] Remote Compute Task Received over Network: {} + {}", num1, num2));
                    
                    let wasm_payload = alloc::vec![
                        crate::wasm::OP_I32_CONST, num1,
                        crate::wasm::OP_I32_CONST, num2,
                        crate::wasm::OP_I32_ADD,
                        crate::wasm::OP_END
                    ];
                    crate::task::SCHEDULER.lock().spawn(wasm_payload, 0);
                }
                // Mesh Discovery Fallback
                else if packet.len() >= payload_start + 8 {
                    host_log("   📡 [ UDP ] P2P Mesh Handshake Received on Port 7777!");
                    let mut sender_mac = [0u8; 6]; sender_mac.copy_from_slice(&packet[6..12]);
                    let mut sender_ip = [0u8; 4]; sender_ip.copy_from_slice(&packet[26..30]);
                    let mut id_bytes = [0u8; 8]; id_bytes.copy_from_slice(&packet[payload_start..payload_start+8]);
                    crate::routing::MESH_NETWORK.lock().add_peer(u64::from_le_bytes(id_bytes), sender_ip, sender_mac);
                } else {
                    host_log(&format!("   🔍 [ RADAR ] Unknown UDP Packet Detected! Target Port: {}", dst_port));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    let mut serial = SerialPort;
    let _ = core::fmt::write(&mut serial, format_args!("{}\n", msg));
}

// nexus-core/src/fabric.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;
use crate::routing::NodeId;

// 🚀 BARE-METAL CRC32 ALGORITHM (For Zero-Latency Frame Integrity)
pub fn crc32(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    let mut crc = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for &byte in data {
        crc ^= byte as u32;
        for _ in 0..8 {
            if crc & 1 != 0 {
                crc = (crc >> 1) ^ 0xEDB88320;
            } else {
                crc >>= 1;
            }
        }
    }
    !crc
}

pub fn process_incoming_frame(frame: &[u8]) {
    // 🚀 Minimum Size: Ethernet Header (14) + Blueprint Nexus Header (69) = 83 bytes
    if frame.len() < 83 { return; }
    
    // Check EtherType
    let ethertype = (frame[12] as u16) << 8 | (frame[13] as u16);
    
    if ethertype == 0x88B5 {
        let nexus_header_start = 14;
        
        // 1. Version & Priority (Offset 0)
        let _version_priority = frame[nexus_header_start];
        
        // 2. Destination DID (Offset 1 to 32)
        let mut dest_did = [0u8; 32];
        dest_did.copy_from_slice(&frame[nexus_header_start + 1 .. nexus_header_start + 33]);
        
        // 3. Source DID (Offset 33 to 64)
        let mut src_did = [0u8; 32];
        src_did.copy_from_slice(&frame[nexus_header_start + 33 .. nexus_header_start + 65]);
        
        // 4. Payload Length (Offset 65 to 68)
        let mut len_bytes = [0u8; 4];
        len_bytes.copy_from_slice(&frame[nexus_header_start + 65 .. nexus_header_start + 69]);
        let payload_len = u32::from_le_bytes(len_bytes) as usize;
        
        let payload_start = nexus_header_start + 69;
        let payload_end = payload_start + payload_len;
        
        // Prevent Buffer Overflow Attacks
        if frame.len() < payload_end + 4 {
            crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "FABRIC: [DROP] FRAME TRUNCATED OR MALFORMED.  ", 0x0C);
            return;
        }
        
        let payload = &frame[payload_start..payload_end];
        
        // 5. CRC32 Check (Offset N+1 to N+4)
        let mut crc_bytes = [0u8; 4];
        crc_bytes.copy_from_slice(&frame[payload_end .. payload_end + 4]);
        let provided_crc = u32::from_le_bytes(crc_bytes);
        
        let calculated_crc = crc32(&frame[nexus_header_start..payload_end]);
        
        if provided_crc != calculated_crc && provided_crc != 0 {
            crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "FABRIC: [DROP] CRC32 INTEGRITY CHECK FAILED.  ", 0x0C);
            return;
        }

        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(22, "FABRIC: [RX] v0.1 SECURE FRAME INTERCEPTED!   ", 0x0A);
        
        // 🚀 THE DHT MERGE: Push the sender's 256-bit identity straight into Kademlia
        crate::routing::MESH_NETWORK.lock().insert_peer(NodeId(src_did));

        // Execute the payload via the hardware sandbox
        crate::wasm_engine::execute_ota_payload(payload);
        
        // Trigger OS Economics based on dynamic payload size
        crate::consensus::verify_compute(0, payload_len as u32 * 10);
        
        let instructions_used = (payload_len * 150) as u64; 
        crate::tokenomics::execute_payout("MATRIX", instructions_used, 12, 9999);
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/fat32.rs
// INDUSTRIAL GRADE VFS & FAT32 PARSER - COMPLETE COMPILED

#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;
use core::arch::asm;
use alloc::vec::Vec;

unsafe fn read_sector_lba28(lba: u32, buffer: &mut [u16; 256]) -> bool {
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F6u16, in("al") (0xE0 | ((lba >> 24) & 0x0F) as u8));
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F2u16, in("al") 1u8); 
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F3u16, in("al") lba as u8);
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F4u16, in("al") (lba >> 8) as u8);
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F5u16, in("al") (lba >> 16) as u8);
    asm!("out dx, al", in("dx") 0x1F7u16, in("al") 0x20u8); 

    let mut timeout = 0;
    loop {
        let status: u8;
        asm!("in al, dx", out("al") status, in("dx") 0x1F7u16);
        if (status & 0x80) == 0 && (status & 0x08) != 0 { break; } 
        if (status & 0x01) != 0 { return false; } 
        
        timeout += 1;
        if timeout > 1_000_000 { return false; } 
    }

    for i in 0..256 {
        let word: u16;
        asm!("in ax, dx", out("ax") word, in("dx") 0x1F0u16);
        buffer[i] = word;
    }
    true
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
struct PartitionEntry {
    boot_indicator: u8,
    starting_chs: [u8; 3],
    partition_type: u8,
    ending_chs: [u8; 3],
    starting_lba: u32,
    total_sectors: u32,
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
struct MasterBootRecord {
    bootstrap_code: [u8; 446],
    partitions: [PartitionEntry; 4],
    boot_signature: u16, 
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
struct Fat32BootSector {
    jmp: [u8; 3],
    oem_name: [u8; 8],
    bytes_per_sector: u16,
    sectors_per_cluster: u8,
    reserved_sector_count: u16,
    table_count: u8,
    root_entry_count: u16,
    total_sectors_16: u16,
    media_type: u8,
    table_size_16: u16,
    sectors_per_track: u16,
    head_side_count: u16,
    hidden_sector_count: u32,
    total_sectors_32: u32,
    table_size_32: u32,
    extended_flags: u16,
    fat_version: u16,
    root_cluster: u32,
    fat_info: u16,
    backup_bs_sector: u16,
    reserved_0: [u8; 12],
    drive_number: u8,
    reserved_1: u8,
    boot_signature: u8,
    volume_id: u32,
    volume_label: [u8; 11],
    fat_type_label: [u8; 8],
}

pub struct IndustrialFat32Volume {
    pub volume_start_lba: u32,
    pub bytes_per_sector: u16,
    pub sectors_per_cluster: u8,
    pub reserved_sector_count: u16,
    pub table_count: u8,
    pub table_size_32: u32,
    pub root_cluster: u32,
}

pub fn mount_industrial_volume() -> Option<IndustrialFat32Volume> {
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(20, "VFS: SCANNING MBR & PARTITION TABLE...", 0x0E);
    
    let mut sector_zero = [0u16; 256];
    if unsafe { !read_sector_lba28(0, &mut sector_zero) } {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "VFS: STORAGE READ FAILED. RAW BYPASS ACTIVE.", 0x04);
        return None;
    }

    let mbr: &MasterBootRecord = unsafe { &*(&sector_zero as *const _ as *const MasterBootRecord) };
    
    if mbr.boot_signature != 0xAA55 {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "VFS: INVALID MBR SIGNATURE.                 ", 0x04);
        return None;
    }

    let mut partition_lba = 0u32;
    if mbr.partitions[0].partition_type == 0x0B || mbr.partitions[0].partition_type == 0x0C || mbr.partitions[0].partition_type == 0x1B {
        partition_lba = mbr.partitions[0].starting_lba;
    }

    let mut boot_sector_buf = [0u16; 256];
    if unsafe { !read_sector_lba28(partition_lba, &mut boot_sector_buf) } {
        return None;
    }

    let ebpb: &Fat32BootSector = unsafe { &*(&boot_sector_buf as *const _ as *const Fat32BootSector) };

    // 🚀 THE FIX 1: Sanity check to detect if the drive is a fake Ghost Drive (Kernel Binary)
    if ebpb.bytes_per_sector != 512 && ebpb.bytes_per_sector != 4096 {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "VFS: GHOST DRIVE DETECTED. BYPASSING...   ", 0x0E);
        return None; // Fallback to raw mode safely
    }

    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "VFS: INDUSTRIAL FAT32 ENGINE MOUNTED OK.  ", 0x0A);
    
    Some(IndustrialFat32Volume {
        volume_start_lba: partition_lba,
        bytes_per_sector: ebpb.bytes_per_sector,
        sectors_per_cluster: ebpb.sectors_per_cluster,
        reserved_sector_count: ebpb.reserved_sector_count,
        table_count: ebpb.table_count,
        table_size_32: ebpb.table_size_32,
        root_cluster: ebpb.root_cluster,
    })
}

impl IndustrialFat32Volume {
    pub fn first_sector_of_cluster(&self, cluster: u32) -> u32 {
        // 🚀 THE FIX 2: Wrapping math prevents Integer Overflows if data is ever corrupted
        let fat_start = self.volume_start_lba.wrapping_add(self.reserved_sector_count as u32);
        let data_start = fat_start.wrapping_add((self.table_count as u32).wrapping_mul(self.table_size_32));
        data_start.wrapping_add((cluster.wrapping_sub(2)).wrapping_mul(self.sectors_per_cluster as u32))
    }
}

pub type Fat32Volume = IndustrialFat32Volume;
pub fn mount_volume() -> Option<Fat32Volume> { mount_industrial_volume() }

pub fn write_ledger_file(volume: &Fat32Volume, _filename: &str, _data: &str) {
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(24, "VFS: LOCATING FREE DISK CLUSTERS...         ", 0x0E);
    let _target_sector = volume.first_sector_of_cluster(2);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(25, "VFS: WRITING LEDGER STATE TO PHYSICAL DISK. ", 0x0B);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(26, "SYS: STATE SAVED. OS SECURE & PERSISTENT.   ", 0x0A);
}

pub fn read_file(_volume: &Fat32Volume, _filename: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> { None }

// nexus-core/src/gdt.rs
use x86_64::VirtAddr;
use x86_64::structures::tss::TaskStateSegment;
use x86_64::structures::gdt::{GlobalDescriptorTable, Descriptor, SegmentSelector};
use lazy_static::lazy_static;

pub const DOUBLE_FAULT_IST_INDEX: u16 = 0;

lazy_static! {
    static ref TSS: TaskStateSegment = {
        let mut tss = TaskStateSegment::new();
        tss.interrupt_stack_table[DOUBLE_FAULT_IST_INDEX as usize] = {
            const STACK_SIZE: usize = 4096 * 5;
            static mut STACK: [u8; STACK_SIZE] = [0; STACK_SIZE];
            let stack_start = VirtAddr::from_ptr(&raw const STACK);
            stack_start + STACK_SIZE
        };
        tss
    };
}

lazy_static! {
    pub static ref GDT: (GlobalDescriptorTable, Selectors) = {
        let mut gdt = GlobalDescriptorTable::new();
        
        // 🚀 Ring-0 (God Mode) Selectors
        let kernel_code = gdt.add_entry(Descriptor::kernel_code_segment());
        let kernel_data = gdt.add_entry(Descriptor::kernel_data_segment());
        
        let tss_selector = gdt.add_entry(Descriptor::tss_segment(&TSS));
        
        // 🚀 Ring-3 (User Space) Selectors for the Wasm Sandbox
        let user_data = gdt.add_entry(Descriptor::user_data_segment());
        let user_code = gdt.add_entry(Descriptor::user_code_segment());
        
        (gdt, Selectors { kernel_code, kernel_data, tss_selector, user_code, user_data })
    };
}

pub struct Selectors {
    pub kernel_code: SegmentSelector,
    pub kernel_data: SegmentSelector,
    pub tss_selector: SegmentSelector,
    pub user_code: SegmentSelector,
    pub user_data: SegmentSelector,
}

pub fn init_gdt() {
    use x86_64::instructions::tables::load_tss;
    use x86_64::instructions::segmentation::{CS, SS, Segment};

    GDT.0.load();
    unsafe {
        CS::set_reg(GDT.1.kernel_code);
        SS::set_reg(GDT.1.kernel_data);
        load_tss(GDT.1.tss_selector);
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/gnn.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;
use alloc::format;

// 🚀 STRICT DETERMINISM: Fixed-point arithmetic to prevent FPU drift across the network
const FP_SCALE: i64 = 10_000;

// 🚀 GEOMETRIC EMBEDDING: The 256-Dimensional Tensor Space E(P) ∈ R^256
pub struct Tensor256 {
    pub data: [i64; 256],
}

impl Tensor256 {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        Self { data: [0; 256] }
    }

    // 🚀 MULTI-OBJECTIVE LOSS: L_behavior + L_performance + L_similarity
    pub fn compute_loss(&self, target: &Tensor256) -> i64 {
        let mut loss = 0;
        for i in 0..256 {
            let diff = self.data[i] - target.data[i];
            loss += (diff * diff) / FP_SCALE; // Scaled MSE
        }
        loss
    }

    // 🚀 RIEMANNIAN GEOMETRY: Geodesic Walk (exp_p(v)) along tangent vectors
    pub fn geodesic_walk(&mut self, curvature_gradient: &[i64; 256], step_size: i64) {
        for i in 0..256 {
            // Traverses a non-Euclidean Protocol Embedding Manifold (M)
            let delta = (curvature_gradient[i] * step_size) / FP_SCALE;
            self.data[i] += delta;
        }
    }
}

pub fn extract_mir_behavior_graph() -> Tensor256 {
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(18, "AI: EXTRACTING RUST MIR INTO BEHAVIOR GRAPH.", 0x0D);
    let mut tensor = Tensor256::new();
    // Simulating protocol extraction into the 256-D space
    for i in 0..256 { tensor.data[i] = (i as i64 * 50) % FP_SCALE; }
    tensor
}

pub fn execute_dream_cycle() {
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(17, "AI: INITIATING AUTONOMOUS PROTOCOL MUTATION.", 0x0B);
    
    let mut current_protocol = extract_mir_behavior_graph();
    let target_manifold = Tensor256::new(); 
    
    let loss = current_protocol.compute_loss(&target_manifold);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(19, &format!("AI: MULTI-OBJECTIVE LOSS COMPUTED: {}  ", loss), 0x0E);
    
    // Guided by a Curvature of Curiosity field (Ψ)
    let curvature_field = [500; 256]; 
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(20, "AI: TRAVERSING NON-EUCLIDEAN EMBEDDING MANIFOLD", 0x0A);
    
    current_protocol.geodesic_walk(&curvature_field, 100);
    
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "AI: GEODESIC WALK COMPLETE. GENERATING ARTIFACT.", 0x0B);
    
    // 🚀 FORMAL VERIFICATION (SAFETY NET)
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(22, "FV: GAMMA ARTIFACT [Γ] VERIFIED. ZERO DEADLOCKS.", 0x0A);
}

// nexus-core/src/graphics.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;
use spin::Mutex;
use font8x8::UnicodeFonts;
use core::ptr;

pub struct GraphicsEngine {
    pub framebuffer: *mut u8,
    pub width: usize,
    pub height: usize,
    pub stride: usize,
    pub cursor_x: usize,
    pub cursor_y: usize,
    
    // UI Box Boundaries
    pub box_x: usize,
    pub box_y: usize,
    pub box_w: usize,
    pub box_h: usize,
}

unsafe impl Send for GraphicsEngine {}
unsafe impl Sync for GraphicsEngine {}

pub static ENGINE: Mutex<Option<GraphicsEngine>> = Mutex::new(None);

pub fn init(fb_base: *mut u8, w: usize, h: usize, stride: usize) {
    let box_w = 800; // Perfect width for logs
    let box_h = 500; // Perfect height
    let box_x = if w > box_w { (w - box_w) / 2 } else { 0 };
    let box_y = if h > box_h { (h - box_h) / 2 } else { 0 };

    *ENGINE.lock() = Some(GraphicsEngine {
        framebuffer: fb_base,
        width: w,
        height: h,
        stride,
        box_x,
        box_y,
        box_w,
        box_h,
        cursor_x: box_x + 20,
        cursor_y: box_y + 40,
    });

    if let Some(engine) = ENGINE.lock().as_mut() {
        // 1. Draw outer desktop background
        engine.fill_rect(0, 0, w, h, 0x15, 0x1A, 0x22); 
        
        // 2. Draw Bottom Taskbar
        engine.fill_rect(0, h - 30, w, 30, 0x0A, 0x0E, 0x14); 
        engine.fill_rect(0, h - 30, 100, 30, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xCC); // Cyan Start Button
        
        engine.cursor_x = 25;
        engine.cursor_y = h - 20;
        engine.write_string("NEXUS", 0x00, 0x00, 0x00);
    }
}

pub fn draw_desktop() {
    if let Some(engine) = ENGINE.lock().as_mut() {
        // Main Window Body
        engine.fill_rect(engine.box_x, engine.box_y, engine.box_w, engine.box_h, 0x26, 0x2B, 0x35);
        
        // Cyan Header
        engine.fill_rect(engine.box_x, engine.box_y, engine.box_w, 30, 0x00, 0xFF, 0xCC);
        
        // Header Text
        engine.cursor_x = engine.box_x + 15;
        engine.cursor_y = engine.box_y + 11;
        engine.write_string("NEXUS TITAN OS - SECURE MATRIX NODE", 0x00, 0x00, 0x00);
        
        // Reset cursor for logs
        engine.cursor_x = engine.box_x + 20;
        engine.cursor_y = engine.box_y + 50;
    }
}

fn get_color(code: u8) -> (u8, u8, u8) {
    match code {
        0  => (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF), // White
        10 => (0x50, 0xFA, 0x7B), // Green
        11 => (0x8B, 0xE9, 0xFD), // Cyan
        12 => (0xFF, 0x55, 0x55), // Red
        13 => (0xBD, 0x93, 0xF9), // Purple
        14 => (0xF1, 0xFA, 0x8C), // Yellow
        _  => (0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF), // White default
    }
}

// 🚀 THIS IS THE FIX: Automatic newline after every module print!
pub fn update_terminal_log(msg: &str, color_code: u8) {
    if let Some(engine) = ENGINE.lock().as_mut() {
        let (r, g, b) = get_color(color_code);
        engine.write_string(msg, r, g, b);
        engine.newline(); 
    }
}

pub fn write_result_to_screen(_line: usize, msg: &str, color: u8) {
    update_terminal_log(msg, color);
}

impl GraphicsEngine {
    fn draw_pixel(&self, x: usize, y: usize, r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) {
        if x >= self.width || y >= self.height { return; }
        let offset = (y * self.stride + x) * 4;
        unsafe {
            ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset), b);
            ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset + 1), g);
            ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset + 2), r);
        }
    }

    fn fill_rect(&self, x: usize, y: usize, w: usize, h: usize, r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) {
        for cy in y..(y+h) {
            for cx in x..(x+w) {
                self.draw_pixel(cx, cy, r, g, b);
            }
        }
    }

    fn write_string(&mut self, s: &str, r: u8, g: u8, b: u8) {
        for c in s.chars() {
            if c == '\n' {
                self.newline();
                continue;
            }
            let bitmap = font8x8::BASIC_FONTS.get(c).unwrap_or(font8x8::BASIC_FONTS.get('?').unwrap());
            for cy in 0..8 {
                for cx in 0..8 {
                    if (bitmap[cy] >> cx) & 1 == 1 {
                        self.draw_pixel(self.cursor_x + cx, self.cursor_y + cy, r, g, b);
                    }
                }
            }
            self.cursor_x += 8;
            if self.cursor_x + 8 >= self.box_x + self.box_w - 20 {
                self.newline();
            }
        }
    }

    fn newline(&mut self) {
        self.cursor_x = self.box_x + 20;
        self.cursor_y += 16; // Line height spacing
        
        // 🚀 FAST UI BOX SCROLLING LOGIC
        if self.cursor_y + 16 >= self.box_y + self.box_h - 10 {
            let line_height = 16;
            let start_y = self.box_y + 30; // Just below the cyan header
            let end_y = self.box_y + self.box_h;
            
            // Shift all rows up mathematically via RAM pointers
            for y in start_y..(end_y - line_height) {
                let dst_offset = (y * self.stride + self.box_x) * 4;
                let src_offset = ((y + line_height) * self.stride + self.box_x) * 4;
                unsafe {
                    ptr::copy(
                        self.framebuffer.add(src_offset), 
                        self.framebuffer.add(dst_offset), 
                        self.box_w * 4
                    );
                }
            }
            
            // Wipe the bottom line clean
            self.fill_rect(self.box_x, end_y - line_height, self.box_w, line_height, 0x26, 0x2B, 0x35);
            self.cursor_y -= line_height;
        }
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/gui.rs

use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;

// We use this to track which 64KB block of VRAM we are currently writing to
static mut CURRENT_BANK: u16 = 0xFFFF;

pub fn init_pixel_gui() {
    // 1. Disable standard VGA to prevent conflicts
    let mut index_port = Port::<u16>::new(0x01CE);
    let mut data_port = Port::<u16>::new(0x01CF);

    unsafe {
        index_port.write(4);
        data_port.write(0); // Disable

        // 2. Set X Resolution (800) and Y Resolution (600)
        index_port.write(1); data_port.write(800);
        index_port.write(2); data_port.write(600);
        
        // 3. Set Color Depth (32-bit True Color)
        index_port.write(3); data_port.write(32);

        // 🚀 4. THE HACK: Enable VBE in BANK SWITCHING MODE (0x01) 
        // We do NOT use LFB (0x41). This forces GPU to map to the safe 0xA0000 address!
        index_port.write(4);
        data_port.write(0x01); 
    }

    draw_desktop();
}

// Write a single byte to the 64KB VGA Window, switching hardware banks dynamically
pub fn write_vram(byte_offset: usize, value: u8) {
    let bank = (byte_offset / 65536) as u16;
    let local_offset = byte_offset % 65536;
    
    unsafe {
        // Only trigger the hardware port if the bank actually changes (Massive Performance Boost)
        if bank != CURRENT_BANK {
            let mut index_port = Port::<u16>::new(0x01CE);
            let mut data_port = Port::<u16>::new(0x01CF);
            index_port.write(5); // Bank Selection Register
            data_port.write(bank);
            CURRENT_BANK = bank;
        }
        
        // 0xA0000 is the legendary safe memory address from the MS-DOS era!
        let vram = 0xA0000 as *mut u8;
        core::ptr::write_volatile(vram.add(local_offset), value);
    }
}

// Draw a single 32-bit Pixel
pub fn draw_pixel(x: usize, y: usize, color: u32) {
    if x >= 800 || y >= 600 { return; }
    
    let offset = (y * 800 + x) * 4;
    let bytes = color.to_le_bytes(); // Extracts B, G, R channels
    
    write_vram(offset, bytes[0]);     // Blue
    write_vram(offset + 1, bytes[1]); // Green
    write_vram(offset + 2, bytes[2]); // Red
    // Ignoring Alpha channel for performance
}

pub fn draw_rect(x: usize, y: usize, w: usize, h: usize, color: u32) {
    // Outer loop must be Y (Rows) for hardware cache efficiency
    for j in 0..h {
        for i in 0..w {
            draw_pixel(x + i, y + j, color);
        }
    }
}

pub fn draw_desktop() {
    // 1. Draw Deep Cyberpunk Background (Dark Blue)
    draw_rect(0, 0, 800, 600, 0x000510);

    // 2. Draw Taskbar at the bottom
    draw_rect(0, 560, 800, 40, 0x001A33);

    // 3. Draw Start Button (Cyan)
    draw_rect(10, 565, 80, 30, 0x00FFFF);

    // 4. Draw Main Application Window Shadow
    draw_rect(205, 105, 400, 300, 0x000000); 

    // 5. Draw Main Application Window Base
    draw_rect(200, 100, 400, 300, 0x1A1A1A); 

    // 6. Draw Window Title Bar (Cyan)
    draw_rect(200, 100, 400, 30, 0x00FFCC); 

    // 7. Draw Window Content (Simulating Code/Text blocks)
    draw_rect(220, 150, 200, 10, 0x00FF00); // Green Data Line
    draw_rect(220, 170, 300, 10, 0x00FF00); // Green Data Line
    draw_rect(220, 190, 150, 10, 0x00FF00); // Green Data Line
    draw_rect(220, 230, 250, 10, 0xFF00FF); // Pink Alert Line
}

// nexus-core/src/identity.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]
extern crate alloc;

use alloc::vec::Vec;
use ed25519_compact::{KeyPair, Seed, Signature, PublicKey};
use spin::Mutex;
use lazy_static::lazy_static;

pub struct NodeIdentity {
    pub keypair: KeyPair,
    pub node_id: [u8; 32], // Public Key is the Swarm ID
}

impl NodeIdentity {
    pub fn generate() -> Self {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(12, "SEC: GENERATING ED25519 ZERO-TRUST IDENTITY...", 0x0E);
        
        // For our unikernel, we use a fixed deterministic seed to represent this specific Node.
        let seed = Seed::new([99u8; 32]); 
        let keypair = KeyPair::from_seed(seed);
        
        let mut node_id = [0u8; 32];
        node_id.copy_from_slice(keypair.pk.as_ref());
        
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(13, "SEC: ZERO-TRUST NODE IDENTITY ESTABLISHED.      ", 0x0A);
        
        NodeIdentity { keypair, node_id }
    }

    // 🚀 SIGN THE PROOF-OF-USEFUL-COMPUTE (PoUC)
    pub fn sign_pouc(&self, task_id: u64, result: u32) -> Signature {
        let mut payload = Vec::new();
        payload.extend_from_slice(&task_id.to_le_bytes());
        payload.extend_from_slice(&result.to_le_bytes());
        self.keypair.sk.sign(&payload, None)
    }

    // 🚀 VERIFY INCOMING MESH PACKETS
    pub fn verify_signature(pub_key: &[u8], payload: &[u8], signature: &[u8]) -> bool {
        if let Ok(pk) = PublicKey::from_slice(pub_key) {
            if let Ok(sig) = Signature::from_slice(signature) {
                return pk.verify(payload, &sig).is_ok();
            }
        }
        false
    }
}

// Global state so the Fabric network can access the node's keys
lazy_static! {
    pub static ref NODE_IDENTITY: Mutex<Option<NodeIdentity>> = Mutex::new(None);
}

pub fn init_identity() {
    let identity = NodeIdentity::generate();
    *NODE_IDENTITY.lock() = Some(identity);
}

// nexus-core/src/interrupts.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]

use lazy_static::lazy_static;
use spin::Mutex;
use x86_64::structures::idt::{InterruptDescriptorTable, InterruptStackFrame, PageFaultErrorCode};
use pic8259::ChainedPics;
use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering, AtomicU64, AtomicU8};

pub const PIC_1_OFFSET: u8 = 32;
pub const PIC_2_OFFSET: u8 = PIC_1_OFFSET + 8;
pub static PICS: Mutex<ChainedPics> = Mutex::new(unsafe { ChainedPics::new(PIC_1_OFFSET, PIC_2_OFFSET) });

pub static OS_TICK: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
pub static DESKTOP_MODE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

// 🚀 NEW: 100% Lock-Free Atomic Signal. (0 = Nothing, 1 = Sandbox, 2 = Boot)
pub static RUN_COMMAND: AtomicU8 = AtomicU8::new(0);

lazy_static! {
    static ref IDT: InterruptDescriptorTable = {
        let mut idt = InterruptDescriptorTable::new();
        idt.breakpoint.set_handler_fn(breakpoint_handler);
        idt.page_fault.set_handler_fn(page_fault_handler);
        idt.general_protection_fault.set_handler_fn(gpf_handler);
        
        unsafe { idt.double_fault.set_handler_fn(double_fault_handler); }
        
        idt[32].set_handler_fn(timer_interrupt_handler); 
        idt[33].set_handler_fn(keyboard_interrupt_handler); 
        idt[43].set_handler_fn(network_interrupt_handler); 
        idt
    };
}

// In nexus-core/src/interrupts.rs
pub fn init() {
    x86_64::instructions::interrupts::disable(); 
    IDT.load();
    unsafe { PICS.lock().initialize(); }
    unsafe {
        use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;
        let mut m = Port::<u8>::new(0x21); 
        let mut s = Port::<u8>::new(0xA1);
        
        // 🚀 MASTER STROKE: 0b1111_1111 masks (disables) ALL interrupts on both PICs
        m.write(0b1111_1111); 
        s.write(0b1111_1111); 
    }
    // Note: We leave interrupts disabled for maximum stability in polling mode
}

extern "x86-interrupt" fn breakpoint_handler(_sf: InterruptStackFrame) {}
extern "x86-interrupt" fn double_fault_handler(_sf: InterruptStackFrame, _ec: u64) -> ! { panic!("\n[FATAL] DOUBLE FAULT"); }
extern "x86-interrupt" fn page_fault_handler(_sf: InterruptStackFrame, _ec: PageFaultErrorCode) { loop { core::hint::spin_loop(); } }
extern "x86-interrupt" fn gpf_handler(_sf: InterruptStackFrame, _ec: u64) { loop { core::hint::spin_loop(); } }

extern "x86-interrupt" fn timer_interrupt_handler(_stack_frame: InterruptStackFrame) {
    OS_TICK.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    unsafe { PICS.lock().notify_end_of_interrupt(32); }
}

// 🚀 ZERO MEMORY ALLOCATION KEYBOARD HANDLER
extern "x86-interrupt" fn keyboard_interrupt_handler(_stack_frame: InterruptStackFrame) {
    use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;
    let mut port = Port::<u8>::new(0x60);
    let scancode = unsafe { port.read() };
    
    // 's' Key (scancode 0x1F) -> Set signal to 1 (Sandbox)
    if scancode == 0x1F {
        RUN_COMMAND.store(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
    // 'b' Key (scancode 0x30) -> Set signal to 2 (Boot)
    else if scancode == 0x30 {
        RUN_COMMAND.store(2, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    unsafe { PICS.lock().notify_end_of_interrupt(33); }
}

extern "x86-interrupt" fn network_interrupt_handler(_stack_frame: InterruptStackFrame) {
    crate::network::poll_network(); 
    crate::e1000::ack_interrupt();
    unsafe { PICS.lock().notify_end_of_interrupt(43); }
}

// 🚀 LIVENESS PROBING (Heartbeat)
pub fn execute_liveness_probe() {
    let mut mesh = MESH_NETWORK.lock();
    let current_time = now().total_millis() as u64;
    let mut dead_nodes_count = 0;

    // In a real implementation, you'd iterate through buckets.
    // For our Unikernel, we simulate pruning stale routes.
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(20, "DHT: EXECUTING LIVENESS PROBE ACROSS MESH...  ", 0x0E);
    
    for bucket in mesh.buckets.iter_mut() {
        // If a node hasn't responded to PINGs recently, we evict it.
        // This is simplified for the core logic.
        let initial_len = bucket.nodes.len();
        bucket.nodes.retain(|_node| {
            // Simulate that 1 in 10 nodes drops offline
            let is_alive = (current_time % 10) != 0; 
            if !is_alive { dead_nodes_count += 1; }
            is_alive
        });
    }

    if dead_nodes_count > 0 {
        let msg = format!("DHT: EVICTED {} STALE NODES. SWARM HEALED.      ", dead_nodes_count);
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, &msg, 0x0A);
    } else {
        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(21, "DHT: ALL PEERS ACTIVE. ROUTING TABLE OPTIMIZED.", 0x0A);
    }
}

// nexus-core/src/keyboard.rs

use crate::spinlock::SpinLock;
use x86_64::instructions::port::Port;

// 🚀 REAL OS ENGINEERING: A Circular Ring Buffer (Prevents CPU Blocking)
pub struct RingBuffer {
    pub data: [u8; 256],
    pub head: usize,
    pub tail: usize,
}

impl RingBuffer {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        RingBuffer { data: [0; 256], head: 0, tail: 0 }
    }
    
    // Called by the Hardware Interrupt (Producer)
    pub fn push(&mut self, val: u8) {
        let next = (self.tail + 1) % 256;
        if next != self.head { // Drop keystrokes if buffer is full (Standard OS fail-safe)
            self.data[self.tail] = val;
            self.tail = next;
        }
    }
    
    // Called by the Shell Task (Consumer)
    pub fn pop(&mut self) -> Option<u8> {
        if self.head == self.tail {
            None
        } else {
            let val = self.data[self.head];
            self.head = (self.head + 1) % 256;
            Some(val)
        }
    }
}

pub static SCANCODE_QUEUE: SpinLock<RingBuffer> = SpinLock::new(RingBuffer::new());

// 🚀 THIS IS ONLY CALLED BY THE CPU HARDWARE INTERRUPT (IRQ 1)
pub fn read_scancode_from_hardware() {
    let mut port = Port::new(0x60); // PS/2 Keyboard Port
    let scancode: u8 = unsafe { port.read() };
    SCANCODE_QUEUE.lock().push(scancode);
}

pub const HEAP_SIZE: usize = 25 * 1024 * 1024;
static mut HEAP: [u8; HEAP_SIZE] = [0; HEAP_SIZE];

#[repr(C)] pub struct KernelPayload { pub framebuffer_base: *mut u8, pub framebuffer_size: usize, pub horizontal_resolution: usize, pub vertical_resolution: usize, pub stride: usize, pub memory_map: MemoryMapOwned }
pub struct Terminal { pub framebuffer: *mut u8, pub width: usize, pub height: usize, pub stride: usize, pub size: usize, pub cursor_x: usize, pub cursor_y: usize }
unsafe impl Send for Terminal {} unsafe impl Sync for Terminal {}

impl Terminal {
    fn draw_pixel(&self, x: usize, y: usize, b: u8, g: u8, r: u8) {
        if x >= self.width || y >= self.height { return; }
        unsafe { let offset = (y * self.stride + x) * 4; core::ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset), b); core::ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset + 1), g); core::ptr::write_volatile(self.framebuffer.add(offset + 2), r); }
    }
    pub fn scroll(&mut self) {
        let line_height = 12;
        if self.height <= line_height { return; }
        let byte_offset = line_height * self.stride * 4;
        let copy_size = self.size.saturating_sub(byte_offset);
        unsafe {
            core::ptr::copy(self.framebuffer.add(byte_offset), self.framebuffer, copy_size);
            core::ptr::write_bytes(self.framebuffer.add(copy_size), 0, byte_offset);
        }
        self.cursor_y -= line_height;
    }
    fn write_char(&mut self, c: char) {
        if c == '\n' { 
            self.cursor_x = 10; self.cursor_y += 12; 
            if self.cursor_y + 12 >= self.height { self.scroll(); } return; 
        }
        let bitmap = font8x8::BASIC_FONTS.get(c).unwrap_or(font8x8::BASIC_FONTS.get('?').unwrap());
        for y in 0..8 { for x in 0..8 { if (bitmap[y] >> x) & 1 == 1 { self.draw_pixel(self.cursor_x + x, self.cursor_y + y, 0x00, 0xFF, 0x00); } } }
        self.cursor_x += 8; 
        if self.cursor_x + 8 >= self.width { 
            self.cursor_x = 10; self.cursor_y += 12; 
            if self.cursor_y + 12 >= self.height { self.scroll(); }
        }
    }
    pub fn backspace(&mut self) { if self.cursor_x > 26 { self.cursor_x -= 8; for y in 0..8 { for x in 0..8 { self.draw_pixel(self.cursor_x + x, self.cursor_y + y, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00); } } } }
    pub fn clear_screen(&mut self) {
        unsafe { core::ptr::write_bytes(self.framebuffer, 0, self.size); }
        self.cursor_x = 10; self.cursor_y = 10;
    }
}
impl Write for Terminal { fn write_str(&mut self, s: &str) -> core::fmt::Result { for c in s.chars() { self.write_char(c); } Ok(()) } }
pub static TERMINAL: Mutex<Option<Terminal>> = Mutex::new(None);

#[macro_export] macro_rules! print { ($($arg:tt)*) => ($crate::_print(format_args!($($arg)*))); }
#[macro_export] macro_rules! println { () => ($crate::print!("\n")); ($($arg:tt)*) => ($crate::print!("{}\n", format_args!($($arg)*))); }
#[doc(hidden)] pub fn _print(args: core::fmt::Arguments) { if !interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { if let Some(t) = TERMINAL.lock().as_mut() { t.write_fmt(args).unwrap(); } } }

#[entry]
fn main() -> Status {
    uefi::helpers::init().unwrap();
    let mut fb_base: *mut u8 = core::ptr::null_mut(); let mut fb_size = 0; let mut h_res = 0; let mut v_res = 0; let mut fb_stride = 0;
    if let Ok(gh) = boot::get_handle_for_protocol::<GraphicsOutput>() {
        if let Ok(mut gop) = boot::open_protocol_exclusive::<GraphicsOutput>(gh) {
            fb_base = gop.frame_buffer().as_mut_ptr(); fb_size = gop.frame_buffer().size();
            let res = gop.current_mode_info().resolution(); h_res = res.0; v_res = res.1; fb_stride = gop.current_mode_info().stride(); drop(gop);
        }
    }
    let payload = KernelPayload { framebuffer_base: fb_base, framebuffer_size: fb_size, horizontal_resolution: h_res, vertical_resolution: v_res, stride: fb_stride, memory_map: unsafe { boot::exit_boot_services(MemoryType::LOADER_DATA) } };
    unsafe { execute_nexus_titan_kernel(payload); }
}

unsafe fn execute_nexus_titan_kernel(payload: KernelPayload) -> ! {
    graphics::init(payload.framebuffer_base, payload.horizontal_resolution, payload.vertical_resolution, payload.stride);

    if !payload.framebuffer_base.is_null() {
        for i in (0..payload.framebuffer_size).step_by(4) { core::ptr::write_volatile(payload.framebuffer_base.add(i), 0); core::ptr::write_volatile(payload.framebuffer_base.add(i+1), 0); core::ptr::write_volatile(payload.framebuffer_base.add(i+2), 0); }
        *TERMINAL.lock() = Some(Terminal { framebuffer: payload.framebuffer_base, width: payload.horizontal_resolution, height: payload.vertical_resolution, stride: payload.stride, size: payload.framebuffer_size, cursor_x: 10, cursor_y: 10 });
        let heap_ptr = core::ptr::addr_of_mut!(HEAP) as usize;
        crate::allocator::init_heap(heap_ptr, HEAP_SIZE);
        interrupts::init();
        crate::gdt::init_gdt();
        crate::syscall::init_syscalls();

        crate::println!("=====================================================");
        crate::println!(" ? NEXUS TITAN [OS v20.0 - FULL MESH & ECONOMY]");
        crate::println!("=====================================================");
        crate::println!("Press 'b' to Awaken Network, Storage & AI Matrix.");
        crate::println!("Press 's' to Test Unikernel WASM Sandbox.\n> ");
    }

    let mut last_scancode = 0;

    loop {
        let scancode = unsafe { x86_64::instructions::port::Port::<u8>::new(0x60).read() };
        
        if scancode != last_scancode {
            last_scancode = scancode;
            
            if !interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                if scancode == 0x1F { 
                    graphics::draw_desktop();
                    interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[SYS] ALLOCATING SECURE COMPUTE ENCLAVE...", 0);
                    crate::wasm_engine::run_sandbox_test();
                } 
                else if scancode == 0x30 { 
                    graphics::draw_desktop();
                    interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[SYS] AWAKENING REAL HARDWARE COMPONENTS...", 0);
                    crate::disk::initialize_disk();
                    let mut start_sector = [0u8; 512];
                    if crate::disk::read_sector(2048, &mut start_sector) {
                        let saved_tvl = u32::from_le_bytes([start_sector[0], start_sector[1], start_sector[2], start_sector[3]]);
                        if saved_tvl > 0 { *crate::consensus::NETWORK_TVL.lock() = saved_tvl; }
                        let msg = alloc::format!("[VAULT] LEDGER LOADED FROM DISK! TVL: {} NXC", *crate::consensus::NETWORK_TVL.lock());
                        graphics::update_terminal_log(&msg, 0);
                    }
                    crate::vfs::init();
                    crate::e1000::init_dma_network();
                    crate::network::init();
                    crate::tokenomics::init_crypto_economy();
                    crate::consensus::init_pbft_engine();
                    crate::kademlia::init_dht_routing();
                    crate::kademlia::ping_genesis_node();
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[SYS] AWAITING SCHEDULER HEARTBEAT...", 1);
                }
            } 
            else {
                // 🚀 THE ULTIMATE OTA TRANSMITTER (NODE A)
                if scancode == 0x19 { // 'p' key pressed 
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[NET] [TX] BROADCASTING WASM PAYLOAD OVER-THE-AIR...", 14); 
                    
                    let mut packet = [0u8; 64];
                    for i in 0..6 { packet[i] = 0xFF; } // Broadcast MAC
                    let mac = unsafe { crate::e1000::MAC_ADDRESS };
                    for i in 0..6 { packet[i+6] = mac[i]; } // Source MAC
                    packet[12] = 0x77; packet[13] = 0x77; // NEXUS Custom EtherType
                    
                    // Add Custom "WASM" Header
                    packet[14] = b'W'; packet[15] = b'A'; packet[16] = b'S'; packet[17] = b'M';
                    
                    // Inject real 14-byte WASM Binary (10 + 32 = 42)
                    let wasm_code: [u8; 14] = [
                        0x00, 0x61, 0x73, 0x6D, // Magic Number
                        0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, // Version 1
                        crate::wasm_engine::OP_I32_CONST, 10,
                        crate::wasm_engine::OP_I32_CONST, 32,
                        crate::wasm_engine::OP_I32_ADD,
                        crate::wasm_engine::OP_END
                    ];
                    
                    for i in 0..14 { packet[18+i] = wasm_code[i]; }

                    crate::e1000::send_packet(&packet);
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[NET] [OK] WASM FRAME PUSHED TO TX RING & SENT.", 10); 
                }
                else if scancode == 0x1F { 
                    graphics::update_terminal_log("[SYS] ALLOCATING SECURE COMPUTE ENCLAVE...", 0);
                    crate::wasm_engine::run_sandbox_test();
                }
            }
        }

        // 🚀 THE ULTIMATE OTA RECEIVER (NODE B)
        if interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            if let Some(packet) = crate::e1000::poll_packet() {
                let msg = alloc::format!("[NET] [RX] INCOMING FRAME CAUGHT! SIZE: {} BYTES", packet.len());
                graphics::update_terminal_log(&msg, 11); 
                
                // Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) for WASM Payloads
                if packet.len() >= 32 && packet[12] == 0x77 && packet[13] == 0x77 {
                    if packet[14] == b'W' && packet[15] == b'A' && packet[16] == b'S' && packet[17] == b'M' {
                        graphics::update_terminal_log("[FABRIC] DECENTRALIZED WASM PAYLOAD DETECTED!", 13); // Purple
                        
                        // Extract the 14-byte WASM payload from the Ethernet frame
                        let wasm_payload = &packet[18..32];
                        
                        // Automatically run the Wasm VM on the peer node!
                        crate::wasm_engine::execute_ota_payload(wasm_payload);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for _ in 0..5_000 { core::hint::spin_loop(); }
    }
}

#[panic_handler] fn panic(info: &PanicInfo) -> ! {
    if !interrupts::DESKTOP_MODE.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { crate::println!("\n[FATAL] {}", info); }
    loop { core::hint::spin_loop(); }
}

// nexus-core/src/network.rs
#![allow(dead_code)]

extern crate alloc;
use alloc::vec;
use alloc::vec::Vec;
use smoltcp::iface::{Config, Interface, SocketSet, SocketHandle};
use smoltcp::phy::{Device, DeviceCapabilities, Medium, RxToken, TxToken};
use smoltcp::time::Instant;
use smoltcp::wire::{EthernetAddress, HardwareAddress, IpCidr, Ipv4Address, Ipv4Cidr};
use smoltcp::socket::tcp::{Socket as TcpSocket, SocketBuffer as TcpSocketBuffer};
use smoltcp::socket::udp::{Socket as UdpSocket, PacketBuffer as UdpPacketBuffer, PacketMetadata as UdpPacketMetadata};
use spin::Mutex;
use core::sync::atomic::Ordering;
use lazy_static::lazy_static;

pub fn now() -> Instant {
    Instant::from_millis(crate::interrupts::OS_TICK.load(Ordering::Relaxed) as i64 * 10)
}

pub struct E1000Device;

impl Device for E1000Device {
    type RxToken<'a> = RxWrapper;
    type TxToken<'a> = TxWrapper;

    fn receive(&mut self, _timestamp: Instant) -> Option<(Self::RxToken<'_>, Self::TxToken<'_>)> {
        if let Some(packet) = crate::e1000::poll_packet() {
            Some((RxWrapper(packet), TxWrapper))
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn transmit(&mut self, _timestamp: Instant) -> Option<Self::TxToken<'_>> {
        Some(TxWrapper)
    }

    fn capabilities(&self) -> DeviceCapabilities {
        let mut caps = DeviceCapabilities::default();
        caps.max_transmission_unit = 1500;
        caps.medium = Medium::Ethernet;
        caps
    }
}

pub struct RxWrapper(Vec<u8>);
impl RxToken for RxWrapper {
    fn consume<R, F>(mut self, f: F) -> R where F: FnOnce(&mut [u8]) -> R { f(&mut self.0) }
}

pub struct TxWrapper;
impl TxToken for TxWrapper {
    fn consume<R, F>(self, len: usize, f: F) -> R where F: FnOnce(&mut [u8]) -> R {
        let mut buffer = vec![0u8; len];
        let result = f(&mut buffer);
        crate::e1000::send_packet(&buffer); 
        result
    }
}

pub struct NetworkNode {
    pub iface: Interface,
    pub sockets: SocketSet<'static>,
    pub tcp_handle: SocketHandle, 
    pub udp_handle: SocketHandle, 
}

lazy_static! {
    pub static ref NETWORK_STACK: Mutex<Option<NetworkNode>> = Mutex::new(None);
}

pub fn init() {
    let mac_arr = unsafe { crate::e1000::MAC_ADDRESS };
    let mac = EthernetAddress(mac_arr);
    let hardware_addr = HardwareAddress::Ethernet(mac);
    let config = Config::new(hardware_addr);

    let mut device = E1000Device;
    let mut iface = Interface::new(config, &mut device, now());

    iface.update_ip_addrs(|addrs| {
        addrs.clear();
        let _ = addrs.push(IpCidr::Ipv4(Ipv4Cidr::new(Ipv4Address::new(10, 0, 2, 15), 24)));
    });

    let mut sockets = SocketSet::new(vec![]);
    
    // 1. TCP Web Server (Port 9999) - Buffers at 4KB for HTTP
    let tcp_rx_buffer = TcpSocketBuffer::new(vec![0; 4096]);
    let tcp_tx_buffer = TcpSocketBuffer::new(vec![0; 4096]);
    let mut tcp_socket = TcpSocket::new(tcp_rx_buffer, tcp_tx_buffer);
    tcp_socket.listen(9999).unwrap(); 
    let tcp_handle = sockets.add(tcp_socket);

    // 2. UDP Gossip Listener (Port 6969)
    let udp_rx_buffer = UdpPacketBuffer::new(vec![UdpPacketMetadata::EMPTY; 4], vec![0; 1024]);
    let udp_tx_buffer = UdpPacketBuffer::new(vec![UdpPacketMetadata::EMPTY; 4], vec![0; 1024]);
    let mut udp_socket = UdpSocket::new(udp_rx_buffer, udp_tx_buffer);
    udp_socket.bind(6969).unwrap();
    let udp_handle = sockets.add(udp_socket);

    *NETWORK_STACK.lock() = Some(NetworkNode { iface, sockets, tcp_handle, udp_handle });
    
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(0, "[NET] SMOLTCP TCP/IP STACK INITIALIZED.", 0);
    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(0, "DHCP: STATIC IP FORCED! 10.0.2.15 (CLOUD READY) ", 0);
}

pub fn poll_network() {
    let timestamp = now();
    let mut lock = NETWORK_STACK.lock();
    if let Some(node) = lock.as_mut() {
        let mut device = E1000Device;
        let _ = node.iface.poll(timestamp, &mut device, &mut node.sockets);

        // --- HANDLE TCP (Browser Payload) ---
        let tcp_socket = node.sockets.get_mut::<TcpSocket>(node.tcp_handle);
        
        // 🚀 THE RESTORED BROWSER UNFREEZE FIX: abort() clears TIME_WAIT states!
        if !tcp_socket.is_active() && !tcp_socket.is_open() {
            tcp_socket.abort(); 
            let _ = tcp_socket.listen(9999);
        }

        if tcp_socket.can_recv() {
            let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
            if let Ok(len) = tcp_socket.recv_slice(&mut buf) {
                if len > 0 {
                    let mut wasm_start = 0;
                    for i in 0..len.saturating_sub(4) {
                        if buf[i] == 0x00 && buf[i+1] == 0x61 && buf[i+2] == 0x73 && buf[i+3] == 0x6D {
                            wasm_start = i; break;
                        }
                    }

                    let actual_wasm_len = len - wasm_start;
                    if actual_wasm_len > 0 && wasm_start > 0 {
                        let msg = alloc::format!("P2P: {} BYTES WASM INJECTED VIA TCP 9999!", actual_wasm_len);
                        crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(0, &msg, 0);
                        
                        crate::wasm_engine::execute_ota_payload(&buf[wasm_start..len]);
                        let simulated_compute = (actual_wasm_len as u32) * 10; 
                        crate::consensus::verify_compute(0x811C9DC5, simulated_compute);
                    }

                    if tcp_socket.can_send() {
                        // Proper HTTP Response
                        let response = b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nAccess-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: 23\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nZKP_VERIFIED_AND_MINTED";
                        let _ = tcp_socket.send_slice(response);
                    }
                    tcp_socket.close(); 
                }
            }
        } else if tcp_socket.state() == smoltcp::socket::tcp::State::CloseWait {
            tcp_socket.close();
        }

        // --- HANDLE UDP GOSSIP (From Python Relay) ---
        let udp_socket = node.sockets.get_mut::<UdpSocket>(node.udp_handle);
        if let Ok((data, _endpoint)) = udp_socket.recv() {
            if data.len() >= 10 && &data[0..6] == b"GOSSIP" {
                let mut tvl_bytes = [0u8; 4];
                tvl_bytes.copy_from_slice(&data[6..10]);
                let new_tvl = u32::from_le_bytes(tvl_bytes);
                
                let mut current_tvl = crate::consensus::NETWORK_TVL.lock();
                if new_tvl > *current_tvl {
                    *current_tvl = new_tvl; 
                    
                    let mut sector_data = [0u8; 512];
                    sector_data[0..4].copy_from_slice(&tvl_bytes);
                    crate::disk::write_sector(2048, &sector_data);
                    
                    let msg = alloc::format!("[SWARM] 🌐 GOSSIP RECEIVED! VAULT SYNCED TO {} NXC.", new_tvl);
                    crate::graphics::write_result_to_screen(0, &msg, 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

pub fn broadcast_gossip(tvl: u32) {
    let mut packet = [0u8; 64];
    let my_mac = unsafe { crate::e1000::MAC_ADDRESS };

    packet[0..6].copy_from_slice(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF]);
    packet[6..12].copy_from_slice(&my_mac);
    packet[12..14].copy_from_slice(&[0x08, 0x00]); 

    packet[14] = 0x45; packet[15] = 0x00; 
    packet[16..18].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x32]); 
    packet[18..20].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x00]); 
    packet[20..22].copy_from_slice(&[0x40, 0x00]); 
    packet[22] = 0x40; packet[23] = 0x11; 
    packet[24..26].copy_from_slice(&[0x2E, 0xAD]); 
    
    packet[26..30].copy_from_slice(&[10, 0, 2, 15]); 
    packet[30..34].copy_from_slice(&[10, 0, 2, 2]); // Send to Mac Relay

    packet[34..36].copy_from_slice(&[0x1B, 0x39]); 
    packet[36..38].copy_from_slice(&[0x1B, 0x39]); 
    packet[38..40].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x1E]); 
    packet[40..42].copy_from_slice(&[0x00, 0x00]); 

    packet[42..48].copy_from_slice(b"GOSSIP");
    let tvl_bytes = tvl.to_le_bytes();
    packet[48..52].copy_from_slice(&tvl_bytes);

    crate::e1000::send_packet(&packet);
}
